title: Dad’s Shoulders
synopsis: Dads carry a lot of weight on their shoulders.

fullText.simplified:
爸爸的肩膀

    中国人常说“父爱如山”。这句话的意思是说父亲的爱虽然是默默的，不善表达的，但是却像大山一样伟大稳重。要想知道父亲有多爱你，看看他的肩膀就行了。
    孩子小的时候，爸爸最喜欢让孩子坐在他的肩膀上。在孩子的眼里，爸爸就像个超人，他的肩膀就是他最厉害的武器。无论路有多不好走，爸爸的肩膀都能稳稳地带着孩子走遍每一个地方，看遍每一处风景。当孩子们长大以后，有些人成为了父亲，他们这才发现原来肩膀很累，让爸爸坚持下去的是他对孩子的爱。
    孩子上学后，爸爸的肩膀是家人生活无忧的保障。爸爸既可以用他的肩膀扛来生活所需，也能用他的肩膀顶住更多的压力，让家人更轻松地生活。四川有一位父亲，因为一张带着孩子工作的照片火遍中国全网，看哭了很多人。这位父亲的工作是帮别人扛很重的货物。他长得又瘦又小，却用他的肩膀为家人扛出了一套房子，让他的老婆和孩子可以过得更好。当记者采访他，问他累不累时，他只是笑了笑说：“累，但是靠自己的努力过日子，心里高兴。”
    待孩子成家立业后，父亲的肩膀变得不再高大，他的背越来越弯，走路也越来越慢，但是父亲的爱开始变得柔软。他会在孩子下班回家前准备好孩子爱吃的饭菜；会在孩子需要经济支持时，默默地把银行卡交给妈妈，推一推妈妈的胳膊，让妈妈交给孩子；还会在孩子有了宝宝后，继续用他的肩膀把小家伙扛起来。
    很多中国的父亲都不擅于表达，他们把爱都放进了行动里。小时候，孩子总是会觉得妈妈更爱自己。长大后，孩子会发现原来爸爸的爱一点都不少，只不过是无声无息地存在在了自己生活的方方面面里。
fullText.traditional:
爸爸的肩膀

    中國人常說“父愛如山”。這句話的意思是說父親的愛雖然是默默的，不善表達的，但是卻像大山一樣偉大穩重。要想知道父親有多愛你，看看他的肩膀就行了。
    孩子小的時候，爸爸最喜歡讓孩子坐在他的肩膀上。在孩子的眼裡，爸爸就像個超人，他的肩膀就是他最厲害的武器。無論路有多不好走，爸爸的肩膀都能穩穩地帶著孩子走遍每一個地方，看遍每一處風景。當孩子們長大以後，有些人成為了父親，他們這才發現原來肩膀很累，讓爸爸堅持下去的是他對孩子的愛。
    孩子上學後，爸爸的肩膀是家人生活無憂的保障。爸爸既可以用他的肩膀扛來生活所需，也能用他的肩膀頂住更多的壓力，讓家人更輕鬆地生活。四川有一位父親，因為一張帶著孩子工作的照片火遍中國全網，看哭了很多人。這位父親的工作是幫別人扛很重的貨物。他長得又瘦又小，卻用他的肩膀為家人扛出了一套房子，讓他的老婆和孩子可以過得更好。當記者採訪他，問他累不累時，他只是笑了笑說：“累，但是靠自己的努力過日子，心裡高興。”
    待孩子成家立業後，父親的肩膀變得不再高大，他的背越來越彎，走路也越來越慢，但是父親的愛開始變得柔軟。他會在孩子下班回家前準備好孩子愛吃的飯菜；會在孩子需要經濟支持時，默默地把銀行卡交給媽媽，推一推媽媽的胳膊，讓媽媽交給孩子；還會在孩子有了寶寶後，繼續用他的肩膀把小家伙扛起來。
    很多中國的父親都不擅於表達，他們把愛都放進了行動裡。小時候，孩子總是會覺得媽媽更愛自己。長大後，孩子會發現原來爸爸的愛一點都不少，只不過是無聲無息地存在在了自己生活的方方面面裡。

sentences.simplified: 中国人常说“父爱如山”。
sentences.traditional: 中國人常說“父愛如山”。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén cháng shuō fù ài rú shān

sentences.simplified: 这句话的意思是说父亲的爱虽然是默默的，不善表达的，但是却像大山一样伟大稳重。
sentences.traditional: 這句話的意思是說父親的愛雖然是默默的，不善表達的，但是卻像大山一樣偉大穩重。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jù huà de yì si shì shuō fù qīn de ài suī rán shì mò mò de bú shàn biǎo dá de dàn shì què xiàng dà shān yí yàng wěi dà wěn zhòng
sentences.english: Chinese people often say, “a father’s love is like a mountain”.

sentences.simplified: 要想知道父亲有多爱你，看看他的肩膀就行了。
sentences.traditional: 要想知道父親有多愛你，看看他的肩膀就行了。
sentences.pinyin: yào xiǎng zhī dào fù qīn yǒu duō ài nǐ kàn kan tā de jiān bǎng jiù xíng le
sentences.english: This saying means that although a father’s love is silent and not well expressed, it is mighty and steady like a big mountain.
If you want to know how much your father loves you, just look at his shoulders.

sentences.simplified: 孩子小的时候，爸爸最喜欢让孩子坐在他的肩膀上。
sentences.traditional: 孩子小的時候，爸爸最喜歡讓孩子坐在他的肩膀上。
sentences.pinyin: hái zi xiǎo de shí hou bà ba zuì xǐ huan ràng hái zi zuò zài tā de jiān bǎng shang

sentences.simplified: 在孩子的眼里，爸爸就像个超人，他的肩膀就是他最厉害的武器。
sentences.traditional: 在孩子的眼裡，爸爸就像個超人，他的肩膀就是他最厲害的武器。
sentences.pinyin: zài hái zi de yǎn lǐ bà ba jiù xiàng ge chāo rén tā de jiān bǎng jiù shì tā zuì lì hai de wǔ qì
sentences.english: When they are still small, dad loves to let his children sit on his shoulders.

sentences.simplified: 无论路有多不好走，爸爸的肩膀都能稳稳地带着孩子走遍每一个地方，看遍每一处风景。
sentences.traditional: 無論路有多不好走，爸爸的肩膀都能穩穩地帶著孩子走遍每一個地方，看遍每一處風景。
sentences.pinyin: wú lùn lù yǒu duō bù hǎo zǒu bà ba de jiān bǎng dōu néng wěn wěn de dài zhe hái zi zǒu biàn měi yí ge dì fang kàn biàn měi yí chù fēng jǐng
sentences.english: In a child’s eyes, dad is just like a superhero. His shoulders are his most formidable weapon.

sentences.simplified: 当孩子们长大以后，有些人成为了父亲，他们这才发现原来肩膀很累，
sentences.traditional: 當孩子們長大以後，有些人成為了父親，他們這才發現原來肩膀很累，
sentences.pinyin: dāng hái zi men zhǎng dà yǐ hòu yǒu xiē rén chéng wéi le fù qīn tā men zhè cái fā xiàn yuán lái jiān bǎng hěn lèi
sentences.english: Whether the road ahead is smooth or not, dad’s shoulders can steadily take his children to every place and to see every landscape.

sentences.simplified: 让爸爸坚持下去的是他对孩子的爱。
sentences.traditional: 讓爸爸堅持下去的是他對孩子的愛。
sentences.pinyin: ràng bà ba jiān chí xià qù de shì tā duì hái zi de ài
sentences.english: After children grow up, some people become fathers. Only then do they find out that actually, their shoulders get very tired.
What keeps dad going is his love for his children.

sentences.simplified: 孩子上学后，爸爸的肩膀是家人生活无忧的保障。
sentences.traditional: 孩子上學後，爸爸的肩膀是家人生活無憂的保障。
sentences.pinyin: hái zi shàng xué hòu bà ba de jiān bǎng shì jiā rén shēng huó wú yōu de bǎo zhàng

sentences.simplified: 爸爸既可以用他的肩膀扛来生活所需，也能用他的肩膀顶住更多的压力，
sentences.traditional: 爸爸既可以用他的肩膀扛來生活所需，也能用他的肩膀頂住更多的壓力，
sentences.pinyin: bà ba jì kě yǐ yòng tā de jiān bǎng káng lái shēng huó suǒ xū yě néng yòng tā de jiān bǎng dǐng zhù gèng duō de yā lì
sentences.english: Once his children start school, dad’s shoulders ensure that the family can live free from worry.

sentences.simplified: 让家人更轻松地生活。
sentences.traditional: 讓家人更輕鬆地生活。
sentences.pinyin: ràng jiā rén gèng qīng sōng de shēng huó
sentences.english: Dad can both use his shoulders to provide for daily needs and also use his shoulders to withstand even greater pressure, ..

sentences.simplified: 四川有一位父亲，因为一张带着孩子工作的照片火遍中国全网，看哭了很多人。
sentences.traditional: 四川有一位父親，因為一張帶著孩子工作的照片火遍中國全網，看哭了很多人。
sentences.pinyin: sì chuān yǒu yí wèi fù qīn yīn wèi yì zhāng dài zhe hái zi gōng zuò de zhào piàn huǒ biàn zhōng guó quán wǎng kàn kū le hěn duō rén
sentences.english: .. making life easier for his family.

sentences.simplified: 这位父亲的工作是帮别人扛很重的货物。
sentences.traditional: 這位父親的工作是幫別人扛很重的貨物。
sentences.pinyin: zhè wèi fù qīn de gōng zuò shì bāng bié ren káng hěn zhòng de huò wù
sentences.english: A father from Sichuan became an internet sensation across China because of a photo of him taking his child to work, making many people cry.

sentences.simplified: 他长得又瘦又小，却用他的肩膀为家人扛出了一套房子，让他的老婆和孩子可以过得更好。
sentences.traditional: 他長得又瘦又小，卻用他的肩膀為家人扛出了一套房子，讓他的老婆和孩子可以過得更好。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǎng de yòu shòu yòu xiǎo què yòng tā de jiān bǎng wèi jiā rén káng chū le yí tào fáng zi ràng tā de lǎo po hé hái zi kě yǐ guò de gèng hǎo
sentences.english: This father’s job is to help other people carry really heavy goods.

sentences.simplified: 当记者采访他，问他累不累时，他只是笑了笑说：
sentences.traditional: 當記者採訪他，問他累不累時，他只是笑了笑說：
sentences.pinyin: dāng jì zhě cǎi fǎng tā wèn tā lèi bú lèi shí tā zhǐ shì xiào le xiào shuō
sentences.english: He is skinny and small, but he used his shoulders to buy an apartment for his family so that his wife and children could have a better life.

sentences.simplified: “累，但是靠自己的努力过日子，心里高兴。”
sentences.traditional: “累，但是靠自己的努力過日子，心裡高興。”
sentences.pinyin: lèi dàn shì kào zì jǐ de nǔ lì guò rì zi xīn li gāo xìng
sentences.english: When reporters interviewed him and asked him if he was tired, he simply smiled and said, ..
.. “Yes, but living by my own efforts makes me feel happy.”

sentences.simplified: 待孩子成家立业后，父亲的肩膀变得不再高大，
sentences.traditional: 待孩子成家立業後，父親的肩膀變得不再高大，
sentences.pinyin: dài hái zi chéng jiā lì yè hòu fù qīn de jiān bǎng biàn de bú zài gāo dà

sentences.simplified: 他的背越来越弯，走路也越来越慢，但是父亲的爱开始变得柔软。
sentences.traditional: 他的背越來越彎，走路也越來越慢，但是父親的愛開始變得柔軟。
sentences.pinyin: tā de bèi yuè lái yuè wān zǒu lù yě yuè lái yuè màn dàn shì fù qīn de ài kāi shǐ biàn de róu ruǎn
sentences.english: After his children have started their own families and established their own careers, a father’s shoulders are no longer tall.

sentences.simplified: 他会在孩子下班回家前准备好孩子爱吃的饭菜；
sentences.traditional: 他會在孩子下班回家前準備好孩子愛吃的飯菜；
sentences.pinyin: tā huì zài hái zi xià bān huí jiā qián zhǔn bèi hǎo hái zi ài chī de fàn cài
sentences.english: His back becomes more and more bent, and he walks more and more slowly. But a father’s love starts to become soft.

sentences.simplified: 会在孩子需要经济支持时，
sentences.traditional: 會在孩子需要經濟支持時，
sentences.pinyin: huì zài hái zi xū yào jīng jì zhī chí shí
sentences.english: Before his children get home from work, he will prepare their favorite dishes.

sentences.simplified: 默默地把银行卡交给妈妈，推一推妈妈的胳膊，让妈妈交给孩子；
sentences.traditional: 默默地把銀行卡交給媽媽，推一推媽媽的胳膊，讓媽媽交給孩子；
sentences.pinyin: mò mò de bǎ yín háng kǎ jiāo gěi mā ma tuī yì tuī mā ma de gē bo ràng mā ma jiāo gěi hái zi
sentences.english: When his children need financial support, ..

sentences.simplified: 还会在孩子有了宝宝后，继续用他的肩膀把小家伙扛起来。
sentences.traditional: 還會在孩子有了寶寶後，繼續用他的肩膀把小家伙扛起來。
sentences.pinyin: hái huì zài hái zi yǒu le bǎo bao hòu jì xù yòng tā de jiān bǎng bǎ xiǎo jiā huo káng qǐ lái
sentences.english: .. he will quietly give his bank card to mom and nudge mom’s arm, telling mom to give it to the children.
After his children have their own babies, he will continue to use his own shoulders to carry the little kids.

sentences.simplified: 很多中国的父亲都不擅于表达，他们把爱都放进了行动里。
sentences.traditional: 很多中國的父親都不擅於表達，他們把愛都放進了行動裡。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō zhōng guó de fù qīn dōu bú shàn yú biǎo dá tā men bǎ ài dōu fàng jìn le xíng dòng lǐ

sentences.simplified: 小时候，孩子总是会觉得妈妈更爱自己。
sentences.traditional: 小時候，孩子總是會覺得媽媽更愛自己。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo shí hou hái zi zǒng shì huì jué de mā ma gèng ài zì jǐ
sentences.english: Many Chinese fathers aren’t good at expressing themselves. They pour their love into their actions.

sentences.simplified: 长大后，孩子会发现原来爸爸的爱一点都不少，
sentences.traditional: 長大後，孩子會發現原來爸爸的愛一點都不少，
sentences.pinyin: zhǎng dà hòu hái zi huì fā xiàn yuán lái bà ba de ài yì diǎn dōu bù shǎo
sentences.english: When they are young, children will always think that mom loves them more.

sentences.simplified: 只不过是无声无息地存在在了自己生活的方方面面里。
sentences.traditional: 只不過是無聲無息地存在在了自己生活的方方面面裡。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ bu guò shì wú shēng wú xī de cún zài zài le zì jǐ shēng huó de fāng fāng miàn miàn lǐ
sentences.english: After growing up, children will discover that actually, dad’s love is no less.

sentence_translations: Dad’s Shoulders
Chinese people often say, “a father’s love is like a mountain”.
This saying means that although a father’s love is silent and not well expressed, it is mighty and steady like a big mountain.
If you want to know how much your father loves you, just look at his shoulders.
When they are still small, dad loves to let his children sit on his shoulders.
In a child’s eyes, dad is just like a superhero. His shoulders are his most formidable weapon.
Whether the road ahead is smooth or not, dad’s shoulders can steadily take his children to every place and to see every landscape.
After children grow up, some people become fathers. Only then do they find out that actually, their shoulders get very tired.
What keeps dad going is his love for his children.
Once his children start school, dad’s shoulders ensure that the family can live free from worry.
Dad can both use his shoulders to provide for daily needs and also use his shoulders to withstand even greater pressure, ..
.. making life easier for his family.
A father from Sichuan became an internet sensation across China because of a photo of him taking his child to work, making many people cry.
This father’s job is to help other people carry really heavy goods.
He is skinny and small, but he used his shoulders to buy an apartment for his family so that his wife and children could have a better life.
When reporters interviewed him and asked him if he was tired, he simply smiled and said, ..
.. “Yes, but living by my own efforts makes me feel happy.”
After his children have started their own families and established their own careers, a father’s shoulders are no longer tall.
His back becomes more and more bent, and he walks more and more slowly. But a father’s love starts to become soft.
Before his children get home from work, he will prepare their favorite dishes.
When his children need financial support, ..
.. he will quietly give his bank card to mom and nudge mom’s arm, telling mom to give it to the children.
After his children have their own babies, he will continue to use his own shoulders to carry the little kids.
Many Chinese fathers aren’t good at expressing themselves. They pour their love into their actions.
When they are young, children will always think that mom loves them more.
After growing up, children will discover that actually, dad’s love is no less.
It’s just that it is there quietly in every aspect of their lives.
